retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s folk-country layout featuring a central framed photograph surrounded by heavy, swash-heavy custom lettering and ornate psychedelic flourishes on a warm cream background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, cream-toned composition featuring a central rectangular photograph bordered by a thin line, topped with massive, interlocking 3D-effect lettering and organic, teardrop-shaped flourishes that extend into a decorative border.
coreVisualRelationships: Interlocking relationship between large display type and organic flourishes
Hierarchical dominance of the artist name over the central image
Framed central photograph acting as a window within a graphic field
Warm color harmony between the cream background and the orange-to-yellow gradients
coreInvariants: Thin-line rectangular frame containing a naturalistic photograph
Ornate, teardrop-shaped graphic flourishes in primary colors

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A rectangular photograph occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, arched display lettering at the top of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large top text, follows the swashes down the left side, circles the central photo, and exits through the bottom-right flourish.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous cream-colored margins surround the central frame and text elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm cream background providing a vintage, aged paper feel.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep orange and yellow gradients within the primary lettering.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red and blue used in the thin-line flourishes and secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-to-medium saturation with a warm, sun-faded value range.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, high-contrast serif with extreme swashes and 3D extrusion.
letterConstructionRules: Letters must interlock or overlap tightly
Ascenders and descenders terminate in large, rounded teardrop swashes
3D depth is achieved through a hard-edged drop shadow or extrusion
Secondary text follows a curved path beneath the primary title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'J' and 'D' feature exaggerated, circular swashes that cradle the surrounding letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A massive, illustrative display face paired with a smaller, simpler slab-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary 70s high-contrast serif feel with ornate terminals.
Captures the soft, rounded weight typical of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm cream-colored background with a central rectangular photograph of a couple in a rural setting, framed by a thin brown line. Add colorful teardrop flourishes in red and blue around the frame corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, custom 3D-extruded lettering in an arched path at the top, using orange-to-yellow gradients and heavy swashes. Add a secondary line of red slab-serif text following the curve below the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the background a warm cream tone?
Does the main text feature 3D extrusion and gradients?
Is the central photo contained within a thin-line frame?

mustAchieve: Balanced use of negative space around the central frame
avoid: Cluttered compositions without a clear focal point

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is arched and interlocking.
Ensure the flourishes do not obscure the central photograph.
Verify the 3D effect on the lettering looks like a physical extrusion.
Confirm the color palette remains within the warm, vintage spectrum.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central framed naturalistic photo with 70s-style swash-heavy display type and organic teardrop accents on a cream field.
